why_me.title: Why me
why_me.block_2: I’m a web developer who enjoys turning simple ideas into clean and functional websites. I’m always learning new things and improving my skills so I can create better experiences with every project. For me, it’s not just about writing code, but about building something useful that people enjoy using.

My_Skills.title: My Skills
My_Skills.lerning_text: I’m currently exploring React and Vue.js to expand my frontend development skills and build more interactive web experiences. I enjoy learning new technologies and applying them to real projects as I grow.

My_projects.title: My Projects
My_projects.about1_text: A simple Jump-and-Run game based on an object-oriented approach. Help pepe to find coins and bottles to fight against the Bigboss.
My_projects.lerned1_text: I enjoyed working on this project because it gave me the opportunity to learn more about (game) development in JavaScript and improve my skills with technologies like JavaScript, CSS and HTML. It helped me understand how these technologies can be used to build more interactive and user-friendly games.
My_projects.organised1: How I have organised my work process
My_projects.organised1_text: I keep my code clean by using clear naming, organizing files properly, and breaking the project into reusable components and modules. I also add comments and documentation where needed and test my code regularly to make sure it stays reliable and easy to maintain.
My_projects.about2_text: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
My_projects.groupExp2_text: The project was completed by a team of three, where we worked together and shared responsibilities at a similar level. My role involved contributing to the development, implementing features, and cooperating with the team to keep the project moving smoothly.
